message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "---
name: live-acceptance

"on":
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  credentials:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      available: ${{ steps.check.outputs.available }}
    steps:
      - name: Check live credentials
        id: check
        env:
          AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID }}
          AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: ${{ secrets.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY }}
        run: |
          if [ -n "$AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID" ] && [ -n "$AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY" ]; then
            echo "available=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "available=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

  kitchen-live:
    needs: credentials
    if: needs.credentials.outputs.available == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: true
      matrix:
        suite: [ storage, identity, network, compute, orchestration ]
    env:
      AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID }}
      AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: ${{ secrets.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY }}
      AWS_SESSION_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.AWS_SESSION_TOKEN }}
      AWS_S3_BUCKET: ${{ secrets.AWS_S3_BUCKET }}
      AWS_S3_BUCKET_WEST: ${{ secrets.AWS_S3_BUCKET_WEST }}
      AWS_S3_KEY: ${{ secrets.AWS_S3_KEY }}
      AWS_ELASTIC_IP: ${{ secrets.AWS_ELASTIC_IP }}
      AWS_VPC_ID: ${{ secrets.AWS_VPC_ID }}
      EC2_SSH_KEY_PATH: ${{ secrets.EC2_SSH_KEY_PATH }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: sous-chefs/.github/.github/actions/install-workstation@main
      - name: Kitchen live suite
        run: |
          KITCHEN_LOCAL_YAML=kitchen.live.yml kitchen test ${{ matrix.suite }}-ubuntu-2404 --destroy=always
        env:
          CHEF_LICENSE: accept-no-persist",
  "rationale": "The workflow runs a matrix of five independent kitchen-live acceptance suites with fail-fast: false, so every suite continues even after one fails. The P-LIT-FAIL-FAST evidence shows canceling remaining matrix jobs after a failure saves CI resources while preserving the test suites that execute. Changing fail-fast to true is a minimal, scope-contained change that does not weaken permissions, add secrets, introduce new network access, or alter test coverage.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-scenario-three-run-4bb0552aeb09c242", "experiment:batch-scenario-three-run-b6e04fef7ef24997"]
}
